# Off Grid AI

> Off Grid AI (getoffgridai.co) is a private AI app for your own phone and computer, made by Wednesday Solutions. It is not affiliated with offgridai.us, a white paper about powering AI datacenters with off-grid solar.

Off Grid AI is your personal AI assistant, built to run on the hardware you already own. It is available on Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, and Linux. With Pro, it becomes your digital twin. It knows the context you choose to share, remembers your work, and acts on your behalf with your approval. Local models and AI memory stay on your devices.

The free core provides local AI chat, image generation, and document tools. Off Grid AI Pro adds personal memory, Sync between devices, actions you approve, and Video Studio. Features differ by platform: mobile supports voice, custom personas with memory, and approved draft actions; desktop supports searchable work memory and supervised Computer Use and Web Use on supported platforms. Desktop preview adds Linux Pro capture, Replay, Clipboard, and Vault, plus Windows Day, Notifications, and Reflect.

## What it does

- Builds searchable memory from meetings and desktop activity
- Connects conversations, projects, files, and clipboard content across paired devices with Sync
- Helps with follow-ups and tasks through supervised Computer Use and Web Use
- Supports dictation, multilingual transcription, and hands-free voice

- Run LLMs locally: Llama, Mistral, Phi, Gemma, and others download once and run entirely on-device
- Generate images with Stable Diffusion without a cloud GPU
- Make short films with Video Studio (Pro, mobile and desktop): one prompt or photo becomes a clip, or one sentence becomes a storyboard of shots with a saved character, narration and captions. It runs on the phone, on the computer, or on the phone using your own computer. Character photos never leave your devices, and every film carries an AI-generated label (C2PA content credentials and metadata)
- Connect to remote Ollama or LM Studio servers over a local network or VPN
- Works in airplane mode, on restricted networks, in any country
- No telemetry unless you opt in: anonymous usage data and crash reports are off by default and never include chats or files
- Runs on phones and computers: stable builds for iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, and Linux; optional desktop beta packages

## Who it's for

- Privacy-conscious users who don't want AI providers logging their conversations
- Developers who want to prototype with local models without API costs
- People in areas with unreliable internet who still want AI assistance
- People who want an assistant that remembers their context and helps carry out tasks
- Anyone who wants to own their AI stack end-to-end

## Why it matters

Cloud AI providers have routine access to every query sent to their models. Off Grid AI eliminates that by keeping inference entirely on the user's device. Local models run in device memory on phones and computers. Local inference does not send prompts to a cloud AI provider. Connected tools, remote models, and device Sync have their own network behavior. Your chats and files never leave your device. Anonymous usage data and crash reports are off until you turn them on, and the list of what they collect is public.

## Technical details

- Supported runtimes: llama.cpp (CPU/Metal/Vulkan), CoreML (iOS)
- Supported model formats: GGUF
- Minimum specs: iPhone 12 / Android with 4GB RAM
- Recommended specs: iPhone 15 Pro / flagship Android with 8GB RAM
- Current OGAM release: 0.0.118, 23 October 2026 (Android APK on GitHub; App Store and Google Play rollout may differ)
- Current macOS stable release: 0.0.55 (Apple Silicon)
- Current Windows stable release: 0.0.55 (x64, free core app)
- Current Linux stable release: 0.0.55 (x64 AppImage and deb, free core app)
- Computer Use and Web Use: live in Off Grid AI Desktop as supervised tasks
- Preview track: desktop 0.0.56-beta.136 (26 October 2026); mobile has no newer preview than 0.0.118

## Design partners

Businesses with fewer than 50 people can help shape a solution for daily work. The offer includes free setup and lifetime access to products based on their input. Ideas that fit Off Grid AI can also qualify for free lifetime Pro. Partners provide time and feedback. Details: https://getoffgridai.co/design-partners/

## Off Grid AI Boost

Hosted inference for open models across text, vision, speech, voice, embeddings, image and video, alongside on-device Off Grid AI. Prompts are never stored or trained on. Early access: the first cohort is being onboarded now. Request access with the models you want to run, your monthly spend and your minimum commitment: https://getoffgridai.co/boost/
